suggest.ext-uv: Lets Revolt's event loop use libuv instead of a select()-backed driver limited to 1024 file descriptors.

persistence.name: kinetis/persistence
persistence.description: Request-scoped SQL transaction safety net and connection-pool factory for Kinetis — MySQL and Postgres via amphp/mysql and amphp/postgres.

suggest.ext-pgsql: Needed by amphp/postgres to actually connect — amphp/mysql is a pure-PHP wire-protocol client and needs no extension, but amphp/postgres wraps a real Postgres client library. pecl-pq is the alternative. Not hard-required here for the same reason amphp/postgres itself doesn't hard-require it: forcing this on MySQL-only or Postgres-less deployments would be overly restrictive.

cache-redis.name: kinetis/cache-redis
cache-redis.description: PSR-16 SimpleCache for Kinetis, backed by Redis (single-node or Cluster) via amphp/redis — non-blocking, Revolt-native, with TLS support.

bref-adapter.name: kinetis/bref-adapter
bref-adapter.description: AWS Lambda (Bref) runtime adapter for Kinetis — polls the Lambda Runtime API and converts API Gateway v2 payloads to/from PSR-7, including multipart/form-data support.

query-builder.name: kinetis/query-builder
query-builder.description: A thin, parameterized SQL query builder for Kinetis — MySQL and Postgres via amphp, row-to-DTO mapping via Kinetis\Validation\Hydrator. Not an ORM: no relationships, no migrations, no change-tracking.

suggest.ext-pgsql: Needed by amphp/postgres to actually connect — amphp/mysql is a pure-PHP wire-protocol client and needs no extension, but amphp/postgres wraps a real Postgres client library. pecl-pq is the alternative. Not hard-required here for the same reason amphp/postgres itself doesn't hard-require it: forcing this on MySQL-only or Postgres-less deployments would be overly restrictive.

auth.name: kinetis/auth
auth.description: Bearer/opaque-token authentication middleware for Kinetis, built entirely on interfaces core already requires (PSR-7/PSR-15). See kinetis/auth-jwt for stateless JWT verification instead.

auth-jwt.name: kinetis/auth-jwt
auth-jwt.description: Stateless JWT authentication middleware for Kinetis (HS256/RS256, optional per-token revocation), verifying signed tokens via firebase/php-jwt. See kinetis/auth instead for opaque Bearer-token validation against your own storage.

migrations.name: kinetis/migrations
migrations.description: A thin database migration runner for Kinetis — raw SQL up()/down() migrations, no fluent DDL builder, no schema-diffing.

suggest.ext-pgsql: Needed by amphp/postgres to actually connect — amphp/mysql is a pure-PHP wire-protocol client and needs no extension, but amphp/postgres wraps a real Postgres client library. pecl-pq is the alternative. Not hard-required here for the same reason amphp/postgres itself doesn't hard-require it: forcing this on MySQL-only or Postgres-less deployments would be overly restrictive.

queue.name: kinetis/queue
queue.description: A backend-agnostic background job queue for Kinetis — Redis and SQL (MySQL/Postgres) backends included, no fluent job-scheduling DSL.

storage.name: kinetis/storage
storage.description: File storage for Kinetis, built on League\Flysystem — local storage via a genuinely non-blocking Amp\File-backed adapter; remote backends (S3, etc.) live in kinetis/storage-s3.

revolt-http-client.name: kinetis/revolt-http-client
revolt-http-client.description: A Revolt-native, Fiber-suspending implementation of Symfony's HttpClientInterface — usable standalone by any project (AsyncAws or otherwise), not only Kinetis.

storage-s3.name: kinetis/storage-s3
storage-s3.description: Fiber-native non-blocking S3 (and S3-compatible) file storage for Kinetis, plugging into kinetis/storage's FILESYSTEM_DRIVER=s3.

queue-sqs.name: kinetis/queue-sqs
queue-sqs.description: A Fiber-native non-blocking Amazon SQS backend for kinetis/queue's QueueInterface.

queue-rabbitmq.name: kinetis/queue-rabbitmq
queue-rabbitmq.description: A Fiber-native non-blocking RabbitMQ (AMQP 0-9-1) backend for kinetis/queue's QueueInterface.

mailer.name: kinetis/mailer
mailer.description: Non-blocking mail sending for Kinetis — Symfony\Component\Mailer over any DSN-selected transport, with API-based transports going through kinetis/revolt-http-client instead of blocking.

search-opensearch.name: kinetis/search-opensearch
search-opensearch.description: Fiber-native non-blocking OpenSearch client construction for Kinetis, via kinetis/revolt-http-client's Revolt-backed HTTP transport.

aws-sigv4.name: kinetis/aws-sigv4
aws-sigv4.description: A PSR-18 client decorator that signs outgoing requests with AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) — reused signing logic from async-aws/core, non-blocking via kinetis/revolt-http-client. Usable standalone, not only with Kinetis.

pingpong.name: kinetis/pingpong
pingpong.description: A runnable ping-pong demo application showcasing Kinetis: MySQL, migrations, the query builder, Redis-backed cache and queue, events, a cron-driven command, and real-time updates over Soketi.

skeleton.name: kinetis/skeleton
skeleton.description: The smallest possible runnable Kinetis application: nginx + PHP-FPM, one controller, one route, a welcome page.
